name: Passlore
summary: Generates passwords, passphrases and PINs right in the browser.
detail: Pick where the password is going and it cuts one to suit. Nothing is uploaded.

name: AwakeTab
summary: Keeps your screen awake for a timed session, and tells you when it is working.
detail: Built on the Screen Wake Lock API, with a ring timer and an installable app.

name: Shareroom
summary: A shared room for working together in the browser.
detail: Open a room to share and preview work from one link.

name: OiBuddy
summary: A small companion in your editor with gentle reminders to drink water and rest.
detail: Animated buddies, guided breaks, focus sounds and a daily progress view.

name: Prismwink
summary: Snap your fingers in Google Meet to vanish into dust and mute your mic.
detail: Hand tracking and the camera effect run on your own computer.

name: BucketPeek
summary: Browse an S3 bucket in the browser, preview any file and spot videos that will not play.
detail: Search, timed share links, and on-the-fly video conversion with FFmpeg and HLS.
